test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: P can do a piece of the work in 18 days and Q can do same work in 36 days. How long will they take (in days), if they work together, to complete the above mentioned work?
solution:
Given:

P can do a piece of the work in 18 days and Q can do same work in 36 days

Concept used:

Total work = Work done each day × Time taken (in days)
